messages:
Priya: Kicking off a 3-day free-credit push tied to next week's webinar (Wed 10am PT). Primary goal: lift first-session activation and seed ~1k users into a prompt-template trial cohort. Funnel experiment — want to validate routing + credit amount.
Sam: Nice. Target audience? new signups last 30d or cold outbound? Also what's success metric (DAU from cohort / conversion to paid)?
Nina: For routing: prefer trial flow for product-ready leads, otherwise route to webinar nurture. Proposed rule: if company_size > 50 & intent_score > 0.6 => SDR; else trial + onboarding. Thoughts?
Jon: Metrics I'd track: activation rate within 24h, median token usage first week, prompt-completion rate. Can we add a canary with 100 users at 1000 tokens each as baseline? Also add event `credit_awarded` with metadata (amount, channel).
Priya: Yep. Canary = 100 users @ 1000 tokens. Full run = 5k users @ 500 tokens. Channel = 'webinar_promo_v1'.
Sam: Schedule for social + email? Need a short benchmark narrative for the post: what's the hook/claim? (one-liner + CTA)
Priya: Hook draft: "Build with LLMs faster — get free credits + curated prompt templates when you join our live dev workshop." CTA: "Claim credits + reserve seat"
Jon: A/B idea: variant A includes 'curated prompt templates'; variant B emphasizes 'free credits only'. We'll compare CTR -> registration conversion. Tag variants with `promo_variant=A|B`.
Nina: Routing config snippet (pseudo):
```
if intent_score > 0.6 and company_size > 50:
  route -> sdr_queue
else:
  enroll -> webinar_nurture_workflow
```
Make sure webhook sends lead_id + credit_code.
MarketingBot: Reminder: webinar landing page needs updated GA tags and `data-promo=webinar_promo_v1` (scheduled deploy 48h before).
Priya: I'll push copy & templates to the doc. Sam can you own social schedule? Jon takes the metrics dashboard (GA + console events). Nina will implement routing rules.
Sam: I can do social cadence. Planning 3 posts: announce, last-chance, day-of. Will post times and sample copy by EOD.
Jon: I'll create the baseline dashboard: goals + segments. Will include cohort comparisons and a small query: `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) WHERE credit_awarded AND used_tokens > 50`
Priya: Great — let's reconvene tomorrow 10am PT for final checks. Slack thread for quick sync. @MarketingBot add calendar reminder.
Sam: :thumbsup:
